reports.text: CEB notice: planned power interruption in Battaramulla tomorrow 09:00-15:00 for line maintenance.
Call centre: 18 customers around Divulapitiya say data is very slow and calls keep dropping.
Social media post: "heard the Divulapitiya tower is already fixed, the company van came" (unconfirmed).
NMS 06:00 | CRITICAL | DIV57 Divulapitiya RBS | BBU not responding, all sectors down
Bulletin 06:00 | RDA/Police bulletin: Minuwangoda - Divulapitiya road CLOSED (flooding, fallen trees)

finding.finding: Verified hardware fault at Divulapitiya (S18) and verified closure of road R18. No other report establishes an operational asset claim.

The resolved state identifies S18 equipment as faulty and road R18 as closed. The action catalogue contains EQ-S18 and BH-L18, but R18 being closed does not by itself establish that travel to S18 is impossible or unsafe; no action is deferred. Work can proceed using other available routes where feasible. No unresolved facts are identified as blocking important work.

S18 (Divulapitiya) is the outage that matters most under the approved weights: it is policy-critical (weight 5), its equipment is confirmed down, and the upstream path is otherwise available. Other listed services have standard weight 1 and no confirmed outage in the supplied state. The road closure affects access, not the approved service weights; the claimed repair is unconfirmed and does not override the authoritative equipment-down snapshot.

limitations: no in-progress work or future-event scheduling
